description.value: Elements Outfitters is a proudly Canadian-owned outdoor gear retailer and self-described leading dealer of Patagonia, Filson, and Hooké in Canada, with locations including this Tsawwassen outlet near the BC Ferries terminal. The store carries a curated selection of durable, purpose-driven outdoor apparel and gear, and is a member of 1% for the Planet. Touring cyclists passing through Tsawwassen could find quality rain gear, layering pieces, and outdoor accessories here.

address.value: 5000 Canoe Pass Way, Unit 105, Tsawwassen, BC
